headline: A Russian military transport plane crashes in Siberia, killing all 19 people on board
summary: An Antonov An-12 military transport plane crashed near the village of Yagunovo in Russia’s Kemerovo region on Tuesday 17 November, killing all 19 people on board, Russia’s Defence Ministry said.
why: Early findings point to equipment failure, according to the Defence Ministry. An investigation is under way.

event.t: The ministry said preliminary findings point to equipment failure, and an air force commission is investigating at the site.
Kemerovo governor Ilya Seredyuk said the plane came down near Yagunovo, about 5 km south of the city of Kemerovo and about 3,000 km east of Moscow.

effects.label: Investigation
effects.t: Air force experts are looking into the cause.
